Subject:  Update on Post Earnings Concall / Meet with Investors / Analysts: 
Audio / Video Recording 
 
 
In terms of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
and in continuation to our letter No. ISC/403/2026-27 dated 12.10.2026 wherein we 
intimated about schedule of Post Earnings Concall / Meet, we have to inform you 
further that the Audio / Video Recording of the said Concall / Meet has been made 
available on our Bank’s website and the same can be accessed through following link: 
 
https://indianbank.bank.in/en/audio-video-recording-concall-transcripts
